About this item

  • 7 Rotatable Joints: Micomlan swing arms led desk light features 7 strongly damped joints with 3 ultra bright light bars design for freely vertical adjustment and horizontal adjustment. You can rotate the bilateral light bars vertically to change the illumination angle. Turn them up to expand the lighting coverage to illuminates your entire desk or turn them down to create a super bright lighting area for sewing crafting. You can also rotate the base to adjust the light direction and position.
  • 45°Angled Away Asymmetric Light: The main light of the clamp light adopts 45° angled away LEDs and side lighting design, it only illuminates your desk and keyborad rather than your screens and eyes. This will significantly reduce the reflected glare on your screen and protect your eyes from fatigue. This office light is suitable for reading, studying, drawing, painting, design and art work.
  • Ambient Lighting & Smart Light Sensor: When the bilateral auxiliary lights shine upwards, they can work as ambient lights to relieve eye strain. The built in light sensor will automatically adjust the brightness accordingly to a comfortable level depending on the surrounding light. The main light and the auxiliary lights of the office lamp need to be turned on or off separately, but the brightness and color temperatures are controlled together.
  • CRI>90 Eye Protection Technology: Micomlan 24W table lamp is equipped with high color rendering index LEDs(CRI>90) to generate soft flicker-free and anti-glare light and accurately render colors, close to the natural light and less blue light hazard. You won't get tired with prolonged use. You can also rotate the left auxiliary light down for eliminating shadows.
  • Multiple Lighting Combinations: Micomlan office desk lamp provides a wide range of brightness adjustment, including multiple color settings across a white-and-yellow spectrum. You can click the touch panel to adjust the 5 levels of brightness and color temperatures step by step, or you can long press the panel for stepless dimming (20% - 100%) and stepless tempering (3000K - 6500K). The memory function will restore your last setting.

Product description

Micomlan rotatable desk lamp features 3 ultra bright light bars design for freely vertical adjustment and horizontal adjustment. You can turn the bilateral light bars up to expand the lighting coverage up to 80 inches. Perfect for large desktop with multiple monitors.

When you need to focus light on sewing, drawing or handcrafting, you can rotate the bilateral light bars down to create a super bright lighting area. Or you can just rotate one light bar down for eliminating shadows.

The metal base can be rotated by 360°to freely change the lighting position.

When the bilateral light bars shine upwards, they can work as ambient lights to relieve your eye strain.

The controls are very responsive and require only the lightest touch to activate.

The main light and the auxiliary lights need to be turned on or off separately, but the brightness and color temperatures are controlled together. The advanced light sensor will detect the level of ambient light in your room and adjust the brightness accordingly to a comfortable level.

Micomlan office desk lamp adopts eye-caring technology to protect your eyes from strain

  • Space-saving clamp supports up to 2.5 inches of the desktop. It takes up less than 4 square inches of space on your desktop.
  • High strength nylon joints are stiff enough that they hold the desired angle without wobbling.
  • All aluminum lamp body, sits very stable on your desk. It can go easily in a high-end modern office.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Just what I was looking for!
    I'll be honest. I was looking for something in my local brick and mortar stores. Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowes... every place let me down because they all had the same unimaginative junk. And certainly not in store so I can just go get it. I have a pretty deep computer desk with dual 27" monitors on moving arms. I also have a separate soldering table. I wanted good, shadow free illumination on both and nobody had anything that would work. Lo and behold, I stumble across this on Amazon. I love when someone has a good idea and turns it into a great product. Unboxing is just ridiculously easy. There is no building. All you have to do is screw clamp it to your surface and plug it in. It seems it'll fit a pretty thick surface too. 1 1/8" (almost 3cm) thick shelf stock for a desk and it has enough space for another inch or so. No flickering that I can see. It's clean smooth light. The color temperature options are plentiful and you can cycle through presets of both temp and brightness or do a smooth transition to what you want. The side panels are separately turned on and off (together) and can fold down 90° (if you really wanted to) or all the way up to upside down on top of the main lamp. It's all folded together in the box, so just unfold and use. Only real issue is there's no telescoping function. So if you have a small desk and want it mounted at the back AND close to your surface, you might have to get creative. The auto brightness is interesting... it gets brighter when the ambient light goes down. I expected the opposite. But maybe this makes sense. I prefer manual control anyway. Overall, very great product for anyone working at a desk, writing, making, what have you. I love this thing already. There's a really good video review that will show you all you need to know. I bought two right then and there (for both tables) and I do not regret my decision at all.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Just what I was looking for!
      Reviewed in the United States on January 27, 2026
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I'll be honest. I was looking for something in my local brick and mortar stores. Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowes... every place let me down because they all had the same unimaginative junk. And certainly not in store so I can just go get it. I have a pretty deep computer desk with dual 27" monitors on moving arms. I also have a separate soldering table. I wanted good, shadow free illumination on both and nobody had anything that would work. Lo and behold, I stumble across this on Amazon. I love when someone has a good idea and turns it into a great product.

      Unboxing is just ridiculously easy. There is no building. All you have to do is screw clamp it to your surface and plug it in. It seems it'll fit a pretty thick surface too. 1 1/8" (almost 3cm) thick shelf stock for a desk and it has enough space for another inch or so. No flickering that I can see. It's clean smooth light. The color temperature options are plentiful and you can cycle through presets of both temp and brightness or do a smooth transition to what you want. The side panels are separately turned on and off (together) and can fold down 90° (if you really wanted to) or all the way up to upside down on top of the main lamp. It's all folded together in the box, so just unfold and use.

      Only real issue is there's no telescoping function. So if you have a small desk and want it mounted at the back AND close to your surface, you might have to get creative.

      The auto brightness is interesting... it gets brighter when the ambient light goes down. I expected the opposite. But maybe this makes sense. I prefer manual control anyway.

      Overall, very great product for anyone working at a desk, writing, making, what have you. I love this thing already. There's a really good video review that will show you all you need to know. I bought two right then and there (for both tables) and I do not regret my decision at all.

      Reviewed in the United States on February 24, 2026
      Color: Black

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      This is a fun-to-use desk lamp with a clamp. It doesn't have the stability of a lamp with two side-by-side arms, however, when I type, it only wobbles a little. I've gotten used to it, so it isn't really a distraction.

      My favorite part of the lamp is the side arms that swing up or down, depending on where you want to put the light. For more focus on your desk; swing down. To illuminate the ceiling, or the entire room, swing up. You can control the brightness or illumination of each type of element, so that the arms that are pointed up can have light, while the ones pointed down can be dimmed or turned off altogether to prevent glare. The brightness starts as very dim and goes all of the way up to very bright (with some glare), and many steps in between. Nice!

      All in all, I've had this lamp for over a month now, and haven't noticed any defects or bad design, except for the slight wobble. It's great if you like to have a room for computer use while having the ability to light the whole room without glare. That's why I give it a '5'.

      This lamp completely fixed that problem.

      The LED lighting is adjustable between warm, cool, and neutral tones, and the three light bars can be positioned independently to direct light exactly where you need it. The clamp-on design is fantastic — it mounts to the back of the desk and sits high above even large monitors, so there’s no clutter and no loss of workspace.

      For about $49, this feels like an incredible value. It also looks clean and modern — not cheap or distracting — and blends right into the office.

      I rarely write reviews, but this one earned it. If you need better task lighting for a desk setup, this is absolutely worth trying.

      OMG I love this. I got a second one for me and one for my son for his room.

      Pretty much good to go out of the box, very easy to put up, stays where I want it, and good range of motion.

      An unexpected plus point: it resumes whatever settings it was on when power is restored. I have them connected to smart plugs, and I can turn them on and off that way. IME these touch button devices usually default to off if you unplug/replug them, so they can't really be used with smart plugs. That is a HUGE plus for me.

      The one issue, if you can even call it an issue, is that it feels like it should rotate where the main lamp part is connected to the arm, but it doesn't. It rotates where the short little part connects to the long par of the arm. Just be careful not to absent-mindedly grab it and try to rotate it in the wrong place. I've done that a couple times and heard a bit of a crack, but it doesn't seem to be broken. Which actually goes in the plus column now that I think about it. It's pretty sturdy, even against stupidity, LOL.

    About this Item

    • 7 Rotatable Joints: Micomlan swing arms led desk light features 7 strongly damped joints with 3 ultra bright light bars design for freely vertical adjustment and horizontal adjustment. You can rotate the bilateral light bars vertically to change the illumination angle. Turn them up to expand the lighting coverage to illuminates your entire desk or turn them down to create a super bright lighting area for sewing crafting. You can also rotate the base to adjust the light direction and position.
    • 45°Angled Away Asymmetric Light: The main light of the clamp light adopts 45° angled away LEDs and side lighting design, it only illuminates your desk and keyborad rather than your screens and eyes. This will significantly reduce the reflected glare on your screen and protect your eyes from fatigue. This office light is suitable for reading, studying, drawing, painting, design and art work.
    • Ambient Lighting & Smart Light Sensor: When the bilateral auxiliary lights shine upwards, they can work as ambient lights to relieve eye strain. The built in light sensor will automatically adjust the brightness accordingly to a comfortable level depending on the surrounding light. The main light and the auxiliary lights of the office lamp need to be turned on or off separately, but the brightness and color temperatures are controlled together.
    • CRI>90 Eye Protection Technology: Micomlan 24W table lamp is equipped with high color rendering index LEDs(CRI>90) to generate soft flicker-free and anti-glare light and accurately render colors, close to the natural light and less blue light hazard. You won't get tired with prolonged use. You can also rotate the left auxiliary light down for eliminating shadows.
    • Multiple Lighting Combinations: Micomlan office desk lamp provides a wide range of brightness adjustment, including multiple color settings across a white-and-yellow spectrum. You can click the touch panel to adjust the 5 levels of brightness and color temperatures step by step, or you can long press the panel for stepless dimming (20% - 100%) and stepless tempering (3000K - 6500K). The memory function will restore your last setting.

    Product Description

    The clamp bracket holds the tall desk lamp steady and supports up to 2.5 inches of the desktop. And the silicone padding on the brackets is soft but firm, they won’t scratch your desk. The clamp lamp is a very solid construction, it provides enough resistance that makes sure the arms are not moving easily by accidentally touching them.
